In practice, this difference is negligible for spike data. (2) The reference code's removeLowFRClusters uses the PSTH (trial-type-averaged data) to compute mean FR, while the AI averages over valid individual trials. These give similar but not identical results since PSTH averaging weights all conditions equally regardless of trial count.
